thread:
anya: Quick follow-up from this morning's outage. We promised concrete remediation items and tests (regression suites, incident prompt sets, load tests, chaos drills). Need owners and dates so we can track.

mike: I can own the regression additions. Plan: add the 10 failing prompts to the fast nightly suite and create a parallel longseq job for the long-context failures. ETA PR by Wed COB.

jordan: I'll curate the incident prompt set. Extraction plan: 50 prompts, annotate expected behavior + severity, upload CSV to evals/incident-sets. Target Fri EOD.

sarah: I'll run the focused chaos drill for KV eviction + fallback routing. Proposed slot: next Tue 09:00 PT, 10m run, validate fallback and alerting. Will draft the drill playbook today.

liam: For realistic KV churn we'll need a sandbox pool with eviction thresholds tuned. I'll request 2 sandbox nodes; need a CAP ticket.

anya: Liam, open the CAP and paste the link here. Sarah, confirm Tue or suggest alternatives. Mike/Jordan, add GH links to your tasks. I'll push items to the remediation board.

liam: CAP-2146 created: https://tracker.redwood.ai/CAP-2146 3 sandbox nodes requested.

mike: Note: harness tweak needed to accept severity labels on incident prompts. I'll include that in the PR.

eng-sre-bot: Reminder: add SLO thresholds to the drill playbook (latency p95, error rate, fallback success).

anja: (typo correction) anya: Timelines recap: mike PR Wed COB, jordan CSV Fri EOD, liam CAP now, sarah drill playbook EOD. If blockers flag now.

sarah: Playbook posted to Confluence and invite sent to runtime teams.

mike: PRs opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5172 (regressions) and https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5173 (harness labels). Dry-run deploy scheduled.

jordan: CSV uploaded: evals/incident-sets/INC-2026.csv and issue: https://github.com/redwood/evals/issues/88

anya: Thanks all. I'll create a recurring monthly "incident-driven evals" reminder and move these tasks to the remediation board. We'll reconvene after the drill to validate fixes and close action items. :thumbsup:
